integrity.computational_role: finite numerical consistency checks; the proof is analytical
integrity.original_source_credit: Arutkin and Reuveni: original rate-refresh model and stationary Fourier transform

scientific_limitations: Exact extreme-tail asymptotic is for fixed positive Brownian diffusivity, exponential reset-intensity law, independent Poisson rate refreshing and origin resetting; not uniform in refresh rate tending to zero. The source provides the exact Fourier transform, and this work derives a sharper asymptotic, not a new transform.
title: An isolated spectral pole determines the extreme tail of Poisson-refreshed resetting
